description: Change a settlement draft: deal type, guarantee, percentage and base, gross or ticket tiers, deductions, expenses, expense cap, promoter. Only the fields you pass change; list fields replace the whole list. Adjustments, chargebacks, tax on fee and reimbursements are kept as they are (edit those in the app). Returns the new server calculation. A finalized settlement must be reopened in the app first. Requires Manage finance.

dealType.description: Deal type: flat (guarantee only), percentage (of a base), versus (guarantee versus a percentage, whichever is higher), plus (guarantee plus a percentage of NBOR over the split point).

deductions.description: Taxes and ticketing fees taken off the gross before NBOR. Replaces all existing deductions.

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

label.description: What the deduction is, e.g. "Sales tax".

anyOf.description: Cap on total allowed expenses as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

expenseCap.description: Cap on total allowed expenses as a decimal string, or null to remove the cap.

expenses.description: Show expenses. Replaces all existing expense lines.

actual.description: Actual cost as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

allowed.description: Amount the deal lets the promoter deduct (defaults to actual) as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

gross.description: Gross box office, entered directly (replaces ticket tiers) as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

guarantee.description: Guarantee as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

percentage.description: Artist percentage, e.g. "85" or "87.5" (at most 4 decimals).

percentageBase.description: What the percentage applies to: gross, nbor (net box office) or nae (net after expenses).

promoterCompany.description: Promoter company shown on the statement.

promoterName.description: Promoter or buyer name shown on the statement.

promoterProfit.description: Promoter profit for a plus deal as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

rowVersion.description: The rowVersion from get_settlement. When given, the update is refused if someone changed the settlement since.

ticketTiers.description: Ticket tiers; the gross is computed from them. Replaces all existing tiers.

price.description: Ticket price as a decimal string in the currency, e.g. "1250.50", "1.250,50" or "1 250,50". Never a float.

title: Update settlement draft
